posts.author: Adarsh_Patil
posts.text: New price band and pre-open rules for ETFs from September 7, 2026 — This should improve price discovery and liquidity across ETFs, as the flexible price bands will reduce instances of ETFs getting stuck at the upper or lower circuit despite a genuine move in the underlying. For Gold and Silver ETFs, the pre-open session will also help capture overnight moves in global commodity prices and arrive at a fairer opening price. However, investors should still compare the traded price with iNAV and use limit orders when volumes are low.

posts.author: rihan_baji
posts.text: New price band and pre-open rules for ETFs from September 7, 2026 — SEBI has introduced new rules for price bands and base prices for ETFs. It has also introduced a pre-open call auction for Gold and Silver ETFs. The rules were originally scheduled to come into effect from September 1, 2026, but the implementation has been extended to September 7, 2026. We’ve published a Z-Connect post here: Z-Connect by Zerodha – 2 Sep 26 Changes to the pre-open session and ETF price bands From September 7, 2026, the way orders can be placed during the pre-open session is changing.
